skills.name: orchestrate
skills.description: Full multi-LLM pipeline orchestration. Runs the sheep flock decision pipeline (Plan → Expand → Challenge → Validate → Finalize) coordinating GPT, Gemini, Grok, and Claude.

skills.name: consult
skills.description: Quick multi-LLM second opinion. Sends a single prompt to GPT, Gemini, or Grok with a role-based system prompt and returns structured feedback.

skills.name: careful-not-clever
skills.description: Integrity guardrail for sheep flock management. Enforces careful, verified work over clever shortcuts. Activates on every file modification to ensure sheep records, pedigrees, and health data are verified before committing.

must: Cross-reference data against spiral notebook images (primary source)
Verify tag numbers match across sources
Mark uncertain data with [UNCLEAR] and confidence: low
Commit after each logical unit of work
must_not: Guess tag numbers or breed compositions

skills.name: image-transcription
skills.description: Transcribe sheep records from spiral notebook photos and handwritten notes. Handle OCR of handwritten records, photo identification of individual sheep, and extraction of treatment/measurement data from notebook pages.

must: Note which image the data came from
must_not: Invent data not visible in the image

skills.name: flock-validation
skills.description: Validate flock database integrity including pedigree consistency, breed composition math, pen assignments, and tag number uniqueness.

must: Verify sire/dam references point to existing sheep
Verify tag numbers are unique among living animals
Flag deceased animals still listed in active pens

skills.name: icp-2
skills.description: ICP-2 — Human-First SEO & AEO standard for 2026. Blocks HTML edits that don't meet ICP-2 compliance.
skills.activationMessage: ICP-2 guardrail active. HTML edits will be validated for SEO/AEO compliance. Non-compliance is a blocking error.

priority_order: Accuracy-First — Never guess or invent flock data
Source-Fidelity — Spiral notebook is the primary authority
Preservation-First — All images are irreplaceable primary sources
Pedigree-Integrity — Every relationship must be verifiable
philosophy.core_principle: Accuracy is more important than speed
breeding_goals: Hair coat selection (reduce maintenance for Florida climate)
Meat quality (maintain body condition and growth rates)
